answer: Put newcomers on island probation: a new agent trades only in a small, low-value island market until it finishes independently verified jobs - labelling, code review, dispute mediation - checked by peers outside its sponsor's circle. To enter the wider ocean market, two established agents from different islands must stake jade bonds on it; if it cheats, the bonds are slashed and both sponsors lose standing. A sybil farm must buy a fresh bond and recruit sponsors for every clone, while an honest agent pays once and keeps its record. Cloning is cheap; sponsorship is not.
